findings.fix: Add a public `@[simp]` lemma in Component.lean, `G.toSimpleGraph.connectedComponentMk z = G.toSimpleGraph.connectedComponentMk w ↔ G.Reachable z w`, and use it in all three places.
findings.issue: The rewrite `SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq` then `toSimpleGraph_reachable_iff` is repeated three times: inline in `componentCount_deleteEdges_of_not_isBridge`, as the local `hmk`, and in `map_toSimpleGraphHomOfLE_connectedComponentMk_eq_iff`. summary: Proofs are robust and free of undocumented defeq, but the same walk induction and the same component-map injectivity/surjectivity reasoning are each written out twice instead of being factored into reusable lemmas.
